excluded_false_positives: E (4 ea, Price 95, ~30x18): SIDEWALL return grille per M601 grille note 11 (heavy-duty steel sidewall grille, 0 deg deflection) - wall, not ceiling. Note 7 on M101: field verify size before ordering.
G (4 ea, Price 95, 36x36): SIDEWALL transfer grilles per note 11; M101 note 3 mounts them at 14'-8" AFF top elev. Four tags = 2 wall openings with a grille on each face - wall, not ceiling.
H (3 ea, Price 520D, 18x8, 550 cfm ea): double-deflection SIDEWALL supply grille per M601 note 10; M101 note 5 mounts bottom of grille at 11'-11" AFF - wall, not ceiling.
I (4 ea, Price 520D, 14x8, 450 cfm ea): schedule THROW column literally reads SIDEWALL, note 10 double-deflection sidewall grille - wall, not ceiling. Field-verify size.
3 hexagon tags with a dash instead of a letter (450 / 450 / 75 cfm): these are EF-1, EF-2, EF-3 ceiling exhaust fans. Fan schedule note 1 says integral grille, so no separate grille to purchase.

Single letters R, S, T, X, M and the small 'D' on M101: piping designators (R=refrigerant, D=condensate, V=vent), thermostats/sensors/fan switches and detail text - not device tags (they are not inside the hexagon tag symbol).
Letters A-J appearing in the M601 grille schedule itself and in the M101 sheet-note column - schedule/legend text, not plan callouts.
structured_output.summary:
CEILING AIR DEVICES TO BUY: 31 total (28 supply diffusers + 3 return grilles), all new, all Price (or approved equal).

SUPPLY - Price SCD, louvered-face square 4-cone steel ceiling diffuser, white, 4-way throw, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling, with radial balancing damper in the neck (Price VCR9) and factory-insulated backpan (M601 grille notes 1, 5, 7, 8, 12):
- Type A, 6" round neck - 5 ea (75/75/75/90/130 cfm)
- Type B, 8" round neck - 4 ea (150/150/140/140 cfm)
- Type C, 10" round neck - 15 ea (2 @200, 4 @250, 2 @300, 3 @350, 4 @375 cfm)
- Type D, 12" round neck - 1 ea (500 cfm)
Subtotal 25 lay-in diffusers.

SUPPLY - Price SMD, louvered-face high-capacity steel ceiling diffuser, white, 4-way, 12x12 face with 8" round neck, flanged frame for SURFACE mounting (hard ceiling), with opposed-blade damper (notes 2, 4, 6, 7):
- Type J - 3 ea (175/150/150 cfm)
Total ceiling supply: 28 diffusers, 6,550 cfm.

RETURN - Price 80, all-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" egg-crate return/exhaust grille, white, 24"x24" core only, in a 24x24 lay-in panel (notes 3, 5, 7, 9):
- Type F - 3 ea (1 at the FCU-1 return in MP Room 119, 2 in Mtg Room 106). M101 note 4: provide a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum atop each of the two Mtg Room grilles.

ALSO IN THE CEILING PLANE (not grille purchases):
- EF-1, EF-2 (Greenheck SP-A700, 450 cfm) and EF-3 (SP-B90, 75 cfm) are ceiling exhaust fans; the schedule says integral grille, so no separate grille is bought for them.
- One extra 14x14 egg-crate, Price model 82, mounted in the soffit with an insect screen on the back (M101 note 19) - outside-air intake, not in the schedule. Buy 1.

NOT CEILING (buy separately as wall grilles, primecoat finish, field-paint 2 coats per note 13): E = 4 ea Price 95 ~30x18 return (field verify size, M101 note 7); G = 4 ea Price 95 36x36 sidewall transfer at 14'-8" AFF; H = 3 ea Price 520D 18x8 double-deflection supply @550 cfm at 11'-11" AFF; I = 4 ea Price 520D 14x8 sidewall @450 cfm (field verify size). 15 wall grilles.

CAVEATS FOR BID: (1) Most supply diffusers are tagged with note 2 - new grille reconnected to existing duct and rebalanced - so they are new purchases but the ductwork is existing; allow for transitions/extensions. (2) Grille schedule flags E and I with an asterisk: field verify exact dimensions before ordering. (3) M601 general note 3 requires coordinating ceiling register locations with the architectural reflected ceiling plans, lighting and sprinklers - confirm lay-in vs hard ceiling for the A-D and F panels before releasing the order. (4) Counts are from the tagged devices on M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan); the gymnasium (127) has no new ceiling air devices.
